verdict.rationale: Archived docs from October 2026 describe a REST interface, API keys and scoped service tokens. Smithery's own later shutdown notice says the Smithery API, Connect, Toolbox, accounts and API keys, and the CLI and SDKs stopped working on October 31, 2026, and that the docs tree was removed. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI paths all return 404, so there is no longer a documented public API to drive the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
